messages:
Maya T.: quick sync — prototype pricing calculator is up on staging (https://staging.redwood.in/pricing/calc). want quick feedback on: FAQ copy, tier names, and two calculator UX flows. keeping this thread for decisions + small a/b test plan.

Jon P.: skimmed it. love the simple sliders. question: the ‘Committed’ tier name reads a bit technical — users might not get reserved vs committed diff. can we test 'Committed' vs 'Committed + Savings' or 'Reserved'?

Priya G.: +1 on naming confusion. also CTA phrasing: 'Estimate cost' vs 'Get committed quote' — one feels exploratory, the other is conversion-y. recommend testing both.

Tom R.: FAQ suggestions — add a short example showing 100k tokens/month with and without prefix caching. Users asked about burst pricing too. propose this snippet for FAQ: 
```
Q: How do I estimate monthly cost?
A: Multiply average tokens per request * requests per month, then apply model rate. Example: 100k tokens -> ~ $X/month on base model; enabling prefix cache reduces token usage by ~20%.
```
Also we should call out Dedicated vs Hosted differences (throughput SLA vs per-token).

Carmen L.: layout note — on mobile the right column (savings breakdown) drops below the fold and the slider UI gets clipped. attaching a quick screenshot in #design (will upload). small CSS fix but need QA run.

Maya T.: good — for naming I'll propose two variants to test: A = [Hobby, Professional, Committed] B = [Hobby, Professional, Reserved]. for CTA: 1 = 'Estimate cost' 2 = 'See committed pricing'. want to run a 2x2 micro A/B on the pricing page funnel (calc impression -> hit CTA -> start signup).

Jon P.: sounds fine. metric: funnel conversion (calc->signup) + micro-metric: proportion clicking CTA. also watch time-on-page to detect confusion. set minimum exposure 2k unique visitors or 4 weeks.

Priya G.: i'll wire up GA goals + set an experiment in Growth. For inbound routing: if users click 'See committed pricing' we should surface an intent tag to sales leads (tag = pricing-committed-interest). Can we add that to the calculator POST?

Tom R.: yes, add a hidden field to the calc payload: {"intent": "committed_interest"} when variant CTA 2 is chosen. dev note: payload is small, use existing /track/endpoint.

Maya T.: plan timeline: today — fix mobile CSS + update FAQ draft. Wed — deploy experiment A/B. next Tue — check interim metrics. will follow up with final copy for help center.

Carmen L.: design will push CSS patch by EOD, and add mobile screenshot examples to the FAQ.

growth-bot: experiment created: pricing_calc_ab_v2 (variants A/B x CTA1/CTA2). tracking id: exp_29812. start: 2026-03-25.

Jon P.: nice. one more ask — include a short sentence near calculator: 'Estimated monthly cost; actual bill may vary depending on sustained throughput and caching.' reduces ticket volume.

Maya T.: added. thanks all — I'll update the staging link after deploy. :thumbsup:

Priya G.: tagging sales@redwood for routing checklist. @sales FYI — leads with tag pricing-committed-interest should be prioritized for SDR outreach.

Jon P.: quick nit: rename 'savings breakdown' -> 'estimated savings' in UI copy. clearer.

Maya T.: done in the copy branch. closing thread after deploy, will post results here.
